messages:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT — service="model-runner-prod" symptom="5xx_increase" window=5m current=18.4% threshold=7%. Auto-alert created.

amy (oncall): ack. i'm live. pulling initial dashboards. p95 and error-rate both spiking. paging runtime and sre.

deepak (runtime): on it. grabbing recent core dumps from pods and the sidecar logs. command: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container AND labels.k8s-pod/model-runner" --limit 200`

nina (sre): adding node metrics. i see memory pressure across 3 nodes and several `OOMKilled` events at 02:12-02:15. Also a surge in requests with seq>10000 tokens.

deepak (runtime): logs show repeated backtraces: 
```
SIGSEGV in mem_map.c:line 129
backtrace: model_runner()+0x4a3, attention_kv_get()+0x1f2, process_request()+0x2b8
```
Kernel messages: `Out of memory: Kill process 3942 (model-runner) score 1580`

leo (support): quick customer check: 4 tickets opened around the spike. customer-X on enterprise tier reports 502s for long context calls. customer-Y (dev) hit 504 timeouts. forwarded to CS.

amy (oncall): initial mitigations proposal: 1) apply ingress request body cap to block extremely large inputs 2) enable fallback routing to small-quant model for heavy routes 3) restart/recreate impacted pods 4) roll back last commit to memory allocator optimization if correlated. opinions?

deepak (runtime): i agree. i already forked a canary without the allocator patch (commit 6b2f9). i'll push that to canary and watch for reduction in OOMs. also will add immediate defensive check in the runner: reject requests with seq > 8192 with a 413/400. PR: https://git.internal/r/model-runner/pulls/3298

nina (sre): i'll add a temporary rate limit for `model-runner-prod` and cordon nodes with repeated OOMs. starting node remediation now.

ops-bot: cordon node=gke-prod-pool-2-07 action=cordon status=success

amy (oncall): leo, ask support to notify affected customers with the current status and the workaround (fallbacks enabled).

leo (support): done — message pasted in #support-ops. customer-X acknowledged and switched to fallback model; they report immediate improvement but some queued requests timed out earlier.

deepak (runtime): canary with allocator rollback deployed to 2/3 replicas. mem usage looks stable so far. logs show fewer segfault stacks.

amy (oncall): i'm applying ingress limit: `limit_request_body 8m;` to reduce huge uploads. will monitor for spikes in 4xx.

nina (sre): metrics update: 5xx down from 18.4% -> 7.2% in last 10m. p95 latency down ~35%. still above baseline but trending good.

deepak (runtime): implemented runtime guard to truncate KV cache growth and return structured error when sequence too large. hotfix branch pushed. requesting expedited review.

carla (product): tagging product/CS: which customers should get an incident summary? we think customer-X and customer-Y were impacted; any others?

leo (support): confirmed impacted list: customer-X (enterprise), customer-Y (dev), customer-Z (startups). CS outreach in progress.

amy (oncall): handing off to tina (oncall-next) — tina you'll have watch for 2 hours. current status: mitigations applied (ingress cap + fallback + canary rollback + pod restarts), 5xx ~6-8%, hotfix PR open. please escalate if 5xx >10% again.

ops-bot: restart pods deployment/model-runner replicas=4 status=ok
deepak (runtime): longer-term action items logged: 1) root cause: allocator optimization + unbounded kv growth on long sequences 2) add unit/integration tests for huge-kv scenarios 3) add graceful rejection path and clearer client error codes 4) revisit autoscaler config to react to memory pressure not just CPU.

amy (oncall): timeline notes:
- 02:11 alert trigged
- 02:13 oncall paged
- 02:16 OOM/segfault patterns identified
- 02:22 ingress limit + fallback enabled
- 02:28 canary rollback deployed
- 02:32 node cordon/drain + pod restarts
- 02:36 5xx trending down; hotfix PR opened

amy (oncall): severity set to Sev2 (customer impact but mitigated). owners: deepak + nina for postmortem, leo for customer comms.

tina (oncall-next): ack. will monitor dashboards for 2h and pick up postmortem notes. add me to the incident doc.

incident-bot: incident INC-2026-0315-11 created. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-runner-oom-triage

leo (support): adding customer ticket links and draft external note. will sync with CS for timing.

amy (oncall): closing live thread, leaving it open for updates. ping here for regressions. :white_check_mark:
